# Ormond Beach Pavers

> Free referral website for homeowners in Ormond Beach, Florida (including Ormond-by-the-Sea). Visitors call or text (386) 242-8812 or send a form, and the request is passed to an independent local paver company for a free on-site quote. The site does not employ crews or install pavers itself.

## Services

- [Paver Driveways in Ormond Beach](https://ormondbeachpavers.com/paver-driveways/): New paver driveways, cracked concrete replaced with pavers, and extra parking pads beside the existing drive.
- [Paver Patios in Ormond Beach](https://ormondbeachpavers.com/paver-patios/): Back patios, walkways, fire pit areas and lanai extensions laid in pavers, travertine or brick.
- [Pool Deck Pavers in Ormond Beach](https://ormondbeachpavers.com/pool-deck-pavers/): Pool decks redone in travertine or pavers, including overlays on old concrete and new coping.
- [Paver Sealing & Repair in Ormond Beach](https://ormondbeachpavers.com/paver-sealing-repair/): Sunken pavers re-leveled, weeds and sand washout fixed, and driveways and patios cleaned and sealed.

## Common questions

- [Homepage FAQ](https://ormondbeachpavers.com/#faq): paver cost factors, pavers vs concrete in Florida, travertine pool decks, overlays, permits and HOAs, sealing
